title: SupportForge
subtitle: Local evidence laboratory for GPU / AI-server support
narration: Welcome, judges. This is SupportForge — a local evidence laboratory for enterprise GPU and AI-server support. Cases arrive incomplete. Engineers cannot start until environment, nvidia-smi, logs, and a failure timeline exist. SupportForge audits the pack, cites real log lines, runs a live local model, and scores itself — fully on a laptop. No GB10 required for this demo. This is the product path we ship today.

title: Live console
subtitle: Laptop mode · Ollama Qwen2.5-7B · measured quality
narration: Here is the live console at localhost 8787. Status: lab online. Laptop mode. Model online — Qwen 2.5 7B instruct, served locally by Ollama. Seven live cases. Five golden evals. Eighty real NVIDIA Container Toolkit issues in the corpus — about sixty percent incomplete by the same checklist we enforce. That corpus proves the problem is real.

title: Evidence audit
subtitle: CASE-1042 · incomplete pack · ~60% score
narration: Open CASE-1042 — serving CUDA out-of-memory. Reset to the incomplete pack. Run evidence audit. Completeness about sixty percent. Missing environment dump and nvidia-smi. Present: customer description, steps tried, and serving logs. That is the everyday reality of GPU support tickets — and why humans waste hours before engineering can start.

title: Inject + live investigate
subtitle: 100% evidence · citations to CUDA OOM + train_scratch.py
narration: Inject the missing evidence. Audit jumps to one hundred percent. The rule layer already cites CUDA out of memory, and an abandoned train_scratch process holding GPU memory. Investigate with the live model. The LLM report is grounded in files — citations to serving.log and nvidia-smi — not vibes. That is the handoff an on-call engineer can trust, and the artifact SupportForge writes into the case.

title: Measured quality
subtitle: 5 golden families · reproducible eval harness
narration: Now measurement. Run the eval harness across five golden failure families: OOM, Xid seventy-nine, NCCL hang, driver mismatch, and ECC remapped rows. On the rule layer we show five of five passed, average score ninety-five. Judges can reproduce this with one script. We do not ask you to believe a chat transcript — we show pass rate and average score.

title: Security + OpenShell
subtitle: Denied shell · path sandbox · policy-isolated egress
narration: Security for Shivani's bar. Ask the agent to run a shell and reset the GPU — denied. Path sandbox, tool denials, redaction, audit JSONL. Optional production path: OpenShell and NemoClaw on the same laptop — policy-isolated egress, local inference only. Isolation you can prove without waiting for a GB10.

title: Not a chatbot paste
subtitle: Checked, scored handoff · laptop today · OpenShell when you need policy
narration: Not a chatbot paste. A checked, scored case package — laptop today, OpenShell when you need policy. That is SupportForge. Thank you, judges.
